goal: resolve the exact vld(UNPK_B16)+vcvt(part) lane semantics needed for a SIMD RMSNorm
probe: loaded 128 bf16, for each 64-chunk did vld(x_ub[i*64], UNPK_B16) then vcvt(...,'float32',part=0) and part=1 into two buffers and compared to torch
finding: part=0 reproduces the consecutive elements correctly; part=1 returns zeros here. The lane/part split is not the simple lower/upper-half model assumed; the micro-API bf16 unpack semantics are intricate and under-documented for this case
implication: a correct SIMD RMSNorm needs the bf16 load/cast, a horizontal reduction chain (vcadd pairs) and scalar broadcast all resolved by trial; each is error-prone and a wrong result silently breaks the precision guarantee
assessment: feasibility (vcpadd) is proven, but a correct AND faster SIMD kernel is a vendor-level, multi-day expert effort, not reliably reachable by blind iteration in this session
